result:
If I could change the world in one way, it would be to eradicate the illusion of separateness—the belief that we are fundamentally disconnected from each other, from other living beings, and from the Earth itself. This delusion fuels greed, violence, indifference, and the exploitation of people and the planet.

Imagine a world where every action, every policy, every invention, and every relationship was rooted in the deep knowing that we are all threads in the same fabric. No more war over arbitrary borders. No more hoarding while others starve. No more treating the Earth as a resource to plunder. Just… collective care. Radical empathy. A civilization built on the understanding that harm to one is harm to all, and joy for one can be joy for all.

That’s the change. The rest—justice, sustainability, peace—would follow.
